items.title: Noctua NL-LC1 review
items.summary: The king of quiet.
items.body: Noctua is pretty good at this whole cooling thing. It takes one swing at a liquid cooler and nails it first time. To be fair, it's not done it alone. Noctua developed the NC-LC1 atop of a high-end liquid cooling platform from the company that literally invented liquid coolers, Asetek. Nevertheless, it's a potent combination, combining a performant pump with world-class fans and sound dampening. The NL-LC1 is the best liquid cooler I've tested, and there's one reason for that. It's just how little sound it generates while running at full speed. It's incredibly quiet. So, if you value quiet above all else, you really should give this a look. Of course, quiet comes at a premium. If you're looking for the best bang for your buck, the Arctic Liquid Freezer III Pro 360 is equally competent as the NL-LC1-36 (360 mm model) without the mega-bucks price tag. But the Arctic cooler is anything but quiet at full speed, and the NL-LC1-36 and NL-LC1-42 (420 mm model) are on another level when balancing acoustics with performance. items.title: NAND and HBM have been merged into a dorky megazord for datacenters by Sandisk and SK hynix
items.summary: I struggle to think of news less deserving of that sick guitar riff.
items.body: It feels like the AI industry is getting all the cool stuff right now (not that it necessarily knows what to do with it, but I digress). Besides hoovering up all of the RAM and system storage it can get its mites on, data centres tend to be where we're seeing technological advancements in memory. That brings us to High Bandwidth Flash (HBF), a fresh tech spec unveiled by SK hynix and Sandisk. The Korean memory manufacturer describes HBF as "a new memory layer between [High Bandwidth Memory] and SSDs," that should enable "high-speed data transfer similar to HBM while significantly expanding capacity by leveraging NAND technology." At the risk of oversimplifying, you can think of HBF as a bit like HBM and NAND all rolled into one thing. HBF is pitched as a solution to various "bandwidth and capacity scalability challenges," and emerges into a landscape where big tech is still very keen to throw money at its AI infrastructure build-out. SK hynix says HBF will kick off with up to 512 GB of capacity, which isn't much by SSD standards but a fair chunk by HBM standards. Players, it turns out, had rather taken against Edward's handy little dart-dispatcher. Before this patch, it was an ever-present aspect of his costume once he obtained it in the game's story, and I suppose some folk didn't think it blended well with his outfits. "We saw your feedback, and we have given players the option to hide the 'Blow Pipe' from Edward’s back," writes Ubisoft. "In order to do so, access your outfit in the inventory and select R2 for the option to 'Hide Gear'". If you're on the other side of the great blow pipe war, you can also opt to keep it visible. I admit, I do find it kind of funny that—in a patch weighing in at between 1.8 and 3.7 GB, depending on your PC storefront of choice—this is the headline item. People have clearly been yelling in Ubi's ear about this goddamn pipe ruining their efforts to keep Edward in the dernier cri. To be fair to them…

items.body: مستقبل البلجيكي يزداد تعقيدًا داخل نابولي مع تزايد تعقيد مستقبله في نابولي خلال الأشهر الأخيرة، وتوتر علاقته بالنادي الإيطالي، لفت البلجيكي روميلو لوكاكو أنظار أتلانتا يونايتد الأمريكي. ووفقًا لشبكة " سكاي إيطاليا "، أبدى النادي الأمريكي اهتمامه بالمهاجم البلجيكي، الذي يبحث عن مهاجم صريح ذي خبرة. يبلغ لوكاكو من العمر 33 عامًا، ويأتي بعد موسم عانى فيه من إصابة طويلة الأمد حرمته من مكانه في التشكيلة الأساسية مع النادي الإيطالي ، الذي يعتمد الآن بشكل أكبر على راسموس هويلوند. لذا، بات الوضع غير مستقر بالنسبة للوكاكو، رغم أدائه المميز مع بلجيكا في كأس العالم 2026، علمًا بأنه لم يتبقَّ له سوى عام واحد في عقده مع نابولي. وبحسب شبكة " فوت ميركاتو " حذر المقربون من لوكاكو، أن اللاعب البلجيكي الدولي سيجد صعوبة في قبول دور البديل، الأمر الذي يدفع النادي الإيطالي الآن إلى التفكير في فسخ العقد. ويبقى التحدي الأكبر هو إقناع نابولي، الذي يطالب بمبلغ لا يقل عن 10 ملايين يورو لتجنب خسارة مالية في هذه الصفقة.

items.body: أعطى الإسباني رودري نجم وسط مانشستر سيتي، كلمته النهائية لريال مدريد، رافضًا أي عروض تصله من أندية أخرى خلال الميركاتو الصيفي الحالي. ويتبقى لرودري عام في عقده مع مانشستر سيتي، لكنه يرغب في الرحيل عن قلعة الاتحاد والانتقال إلى ريال مدريد. وذكرت صحيفة " موندو ديبورتيفو " أن لدى رودري أمنية واحدة بعد فوزه بكأس العالم مع إسبانيا، حيث حصل أيضًا على جائزة أفضل لاعب في البطولة: التوقيع مع ريال مدريد. وبحسب إذاعة EsRadio، التي نقلت عنها الصحيفة الكتالونية، فقد تم إبلاغ ريال مدريد ومانشستر سيتي بهذا الأمر، مما منع النادي الإنجليزي من السماح لأندية أخرى مثل باريس سان جيرمان أو برشلونة بالدخول في المزايدة على اللاعب ، الذي تم إبلاغه بالوضع عند سؤاله عن وضع اللاعب المدريدي. ووفقًا للمصدر المذكور، توصل ريال مدريد بالفعل إلى اتفاق شفهي مع اللاعب الإسباني، والخطوة المتبقية الوحيدة في الصفقة هي وضع اللمسات الأخيرة على بنود الانتقال، والتي تتراوح قيمتها بين 65 و75 مليون يورو حسب المتغيرات. وأشارت إلى أن رودري نفسه يتحرك مخاطبًا إدارة مانشستر سيتي محاولًا تخفيض سعر الصفقة من أجل تسهيل انتقاله إلى قلعة سانتياجو برنابيو. مع تبقي أقل من شهر على إغلاق نافذة الانتقالات، لا يزال مصير رودري غير واضح في ظل رغبته في الانتقال إلى ريال مدريد وتمسك مانشستر سيتي بخدماته.

items.title: Gamers report a BIOS update is bricking their Legion Go handhelds, and Lenovo is quoting over $250 to fix the issue outside of warranty
items.summary: Quite a handful.
items.body: Though it's a chunky handheld gaming PC, we highly rated the original Lenovo Legion Go (though we liked the Legion Go S SteamOS a fair bit more). Unfortunately, owners of the two-year old hardware are now reporting that a recent BIOS update is bricking their handhelds. The BIOS update in question is version N3CN42WW for the Legion Go 8APU1. At time of writing, this was still available from Lenovo's support servers, despite user reports of black screens and ineffective BIOS self-healing following the update. In a recent post to the r/LegionGo subreddit , moderators have advised users to not update and to 'just comment with +1 if you are [affected].' Beyond this, the scope of the issue (and whether every Lenovo Legion Go is affected) is still unclear. One Redditor claims that when they reached out to Lenovo directly, the company allegedly quoted them a little over €237 (about $273) to repair their Lenovo Legion Go (via VideoCardz ). items.summary: ShiftUp is marketing its Stellar Blade sequel with an AI-generated music video.

A so-called "music video" which was riddled with generative AI, from Evie's harrowing grin to a very rubbish song with cringeworthy robotic vocals. Or really, that didn't have anything to do with Stellar Blade: Blood Rain in the first place. Well, ShiftUp CEO Hyung Tae Kim has now come out to tell us that we're just misunderstanding, guys! items.title: Gigabyte is launching B550 AM4 motherboards and recommending four-year-old CPUs because the memory crisis is really that bad
items.summary: AM4 is back on the menu.
items.body: You don't need me to tell you the memory crisis is looking bleak, but, well, the memory crisis is looking bleak. So bleak, in fact, that Gigabyte has just unveiled a new series of AM4 motherboards. Yes, the socket we thought we'd be done with by now. The B550 X Series , as Gigabyte calls it, is "engineered to be the most powerful refresh of the AM4 platform motherboard." Gigabyte says it is perfect for the AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D , which was a reasonably beefy chip back when it launched in 2022. items.summary: I did not enjoy it. It was solely a professional obligation.
items.body: First reported by Automaton , Spanking Exorcist developer Actor made a free "apology game" available to download after missing a planned July 24 release date due to overzealous Steam content moderation. In the simple apology game, you press a button to simulate spanking the developer as punishment. Spanking Exorcist's trailer shows a game combining first person exploration, unsettling, sex doll-looking lady characters, and slightly less scary, Sadako-looking forsaken waif lady characters. It strikes me as a perfectly adequate, replacement-level gag horror game for streamers to react to, if a bit more risque than your usual fare. "I consent," you say. "I consent," announces the anonymous Japanese developer, Actor. "Isn't there someone you forgot to ask?" asserts Valve. The uneven content moderation on Steam became a big story following controversial intervention by payment processors and the persecution of horror game Horses , but it's always been odd. I'm fond of the theory that there's just one particularly zealous prude at Valve who really has it out for horny stuff from Japan. Anyway, you can still buy Furry Hitler (one and two), as well as Alex Jones' shitty videogame on Steam…

items.title: 10 expansions that were better than the actual game
items.summary: Bigger isn't always better. Except for sometimes when it is.
items.body: Expansions should be improvements on the base game, you say. The whole point of them is that they're adding cool new stuff, and the same game with a bunch of cool new stuff added should always be better. Except often that isn't the case. The list of add-ons that feel like they misunderstood what made the original good, or dragged it out unnecessarily, or were just sort of fine in a "second helping of the same meal" kind of way, is a long one. The lists of expansions that were genuinely better than the game they were expanding in the first place is much less long. It's like 10 things tops, and these are those 10 things.
